name: Linux runtime (gamescope + native ARM Steam)
note: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 rootfs with gamescope 3.16, Xwayland, Mesa 26.2 (Turnip with the KGSL backend, Zink), GTK 2, PulseAudio and Bannerlator's session scripts. Installed by the app into files/linuxfs; a gamescope session refuses to start without it. r7 passes the panel's own refresh rate to gamescope: it was only passed when an FPS limiter was set, and gamescope defaults to 60, so games offered 60 Hz and nothing else on a 120 Hz screen and capped themselves there. An FPS limiter still overrides it. Carried over from r6: installed Windows titles are set to the ARM64 Proton automatically. Carried over from r5: the same proot at opt/android-host, so the runtime installs and runs without root and an app update cannot replace it; the tool is listed as Bannerlator Proton (ARM64) so it is not mistaken for Valve's own ARM64 Protons, which need user namespaces Android does not give. Contains no Valve software - the native arm64 Steam client is fetched from Valve at first use. Built from tools/linuxfs in the Bannerlator repo; ported from WinNative's gamescope runtime (GPL-3.0).
